paras: Anolis chloris, also known commonly as Boulenger's green anole, is a species of lizard in the family Anolidae. The species is native to southern Central America and northwestern South America.
Anolis chloris is found in Colombia, Ecuador, and Panama.
The preferred natural habitat of Anolis chloris is forest at elevations from near sea level to 1,700 m (5,600 ft).
The specific name of a synonym, palmeri, is in honor of English naturalist Mervyn George Palmer (1882–1954), who collected the holotype.
